title: Handcrafted Datasets
definition: The creation of small, meticulously crafted datasets for training AI models, providing better results compared to large, generated datasets.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Using personal time and effort to create specific, high-quality datasets for training AI models, instead of using large, computer-generated ones.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The practice of manually constructing smaller, more focused datasets for training AI models, resulting in better model performance compared to using larger, automatically generated datasets.
difficulty_levels.expert: The strategic creation of smaller, carefully crafted datasets for AI training that outperform larger, automatically generated datasets due to their focused nature and quality control.

extra_fields.insight: Small, handcrafted datasets can yield better results than large, generated datasets in AI training.
